orders_rows_still_unknown.why: `orders` is append-only and a row records what we knew when we wrote it. Appending a second row would double the leg for M1/M3/§4-5b and rewriting the first would erase the evidence that we did not know. Repairing these needs a correction row type with an explicit supersedes link — a schema change, not a job. The `fills` rows recovered above are additive and carry no such hazard.
